data_catalog.description: Production-grade mock data catalog for Data Discovery Agent POC. Contains one test scenario: Daily Campaign Impressions and Clicks. Conformed data exists in the silver layer, the raw unconformed event feed exists in the bronze layer, and no gold consumption table currently exists for this use case.

silver.description: Conformed campaign impression event table. One row per campaign impression event. Daily campaign impressions can be calculated by counting impression_id by campaign_id, campaign_name, and event date derived from timestamp.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.description: Unique campaign identifier

columns.name: campaign_name
columns.description: Business-readable campaign name

columns.name: timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the campaign impression event occurred

columns.name: impression_id
columns.description: Unique campaign impression event identifier. Count of impression_id gives impressions for a campaign at a date grain.

silver.description: Conformed campaign click event table. One row per campaign click event. Daily campaign clicks can be calculated by counting click_id by campaign_id, campaign_name, and event date derived from timestamp.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.description: Unique campaign identifier

columns.name: campaign_name
columns.description: Business-readable campaign name

columns.name: timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the campaign click event occurred

columns.name: click_id
columns.description: Unique campaign click event identifier. Count of click_id gives clicks for a campaign at a date grain.

silver.description: Reporting-friendly daily aggregate. One row per campaign + channel + day. Pre-aggregated from slv_impression_event, slv_click_event, and slv_conversion_event. CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS are derived at the gold layer — raw counts and sums are stored here. Composite PK: (date, campaign_id, channel).
silver.refresh_cadence: Daily (04:00 UTC, after event tables are loaded)

columns.name: channel

columns.description: COUNT of impression_id from slv_impression_event for this day+campaign+channel

columns.name: clicks
columns.description: COUNT of click_id from slv_click_event for this day+campaign+channel

columns.name: conversions
columns.description: COUNT of conversion_id from slv_conversion_event for this day+campaign

columns.name: spend
columns.description: SUM of cost from slv_click_event for this day+campaign+channel

columns.name: revenue
columns.description: SUM of conversion_value from slv_conversion_event — null when not tracked

bronze.description: Raw ad-server event feed landing impression and click events on a single stream, keyed by event_type. Append-only landing table — unconformed: inconsistent casing on event_type / campaign_name / device_type, string-typed boolean (is_billable), untyped timestamp (event_ts, no timezone). Each event carries either an impression_id (impression events) or a click_id (click events). This raw feed is conformed and split into the silver tables campaign_impressions_conformed and campaign_clicks_conformed. Daily impressions/clicks can be derived by counting impression_id / click_id by campaign_id, campaign_name, and event date once conformed.
upstream_lineage: External: Ad Server event stream → ADLS raw zone

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: Raw event type — routes the row to impressions or clicks. Inconsistent casing (e.g. impression, Impression, IMPRESSION, click, Click, CLICK).

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.description: Raw campaign identifier for attribution

columns.name: campaign_name
columns.description: Raw business-readable campaign name — inconsistent casing (e.g. Spring Sale 2026, spring sale 2026, SPRING SALE 2026)

columns.name: event_ts
columns.description: Raw event timestamp from source system (format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, no timezone). Conforms to the silver timestamp column.

columns.name: impression_id
columns.description: Raw impression event identifier — populated when event_type is an impression; blank for click events. Count of impression_id gives impressions for a campaign at a date grain.

columns.name: click_id
columns.description: Raw click event identifier — populated when event_type is a click; blank for impression events. Count of click_id gives clicks for a campaign at a date grain.

columns.name: device_type
columns.description: Raw device type — inconsistent casing (e.g. Mobile, mobile, DESKTOP, Tablet, tablet)

columns.name: is_billable
columns.description: Raw billable-event flag — stored as string (true/false), not boolean

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Source CSV file name from ingestion batch

columns.name: ingestion_ts
columns.description: Ingestion timestamp — stored as string, not typed timestamp

missing_information: Raw event feed is unconformed — requires case normalisation (event_type, campaign_name, device_type), timestamp typing (event_ts), and boolean coercion (is_billable) before serving impressions/clicks reliably
Impression and click events share one feed and must be split by event_type to populate the conformed silver tables

foundry_iq_index.description_match_summary: Table contains campaign_id, campaign_name, timestamp, and impression_id. Counting impression_id by campaign and date supports daily campaign impressions.
Table contains campaign_id, campaign_name, timestamp, and click_id. Counting click_id by campaign and date supports daily campaign clicks.
Direct match for campaign impression events with impression_id available for counting.
Direct match for campaign click events with click_id available for counting.

foundry_iq_index.query_term: raw ad-server impression and click events
foundry_iq_index.description_match_summary: Raw landing feed for campaign impression and click events. Carries impression_id, click_id, campaign_id, campaign_name and an untyped event_ts; requires conforming before reuse. Feeds the campaign_impressions_conformed and campaign_clicks_conformed silver tables.
No gold consumption table currently exists for daily campaign impressions and clicks.

foundry_iq_index.query_term: campaign performance with spend and conversions
foundry_iq_index.description_match_summary: Pre-aggregated daily performance table with impressions, clicks, conversions, spend, and revenue per campaign and channel. Supports CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS derivation at the gold layer.
One row per ad view with channel and device_type. COUNT(impression_id) by channel/device_type/date gives impression breakdown.

foundry_iq_index.query_term: campaign spend and cost per click
foundry_iq_index.description_match_summary: One row per click with cost column (CPC or allocated cost). SUM(cost) gives total spend; SUM(cost)/COUNT(click_id) gives CPC.
One row per conversion with conversion_type and conversion_value. COUNT(conversion_id) gives conversions; SUM(conversion_value) gives revenue for ROAS calculation.

foundry_iq_index.query_term: CTR CPC CPA ROAS campaign metrics
foundry_iq_index.description_match_summary: Daily aggregate with impressions, clicks, conversions, spend, revenue. All four campaign performance metrics (CTR=clicks/impressions, CPC=spend/clicks, CPA=spend/conversions, ROAS=revenue/spend) can be derived from this table.
alias_mappings: spend ↔ CPC numerator / CPA numerator / ROAS denominator (0.93)

foundry_iq_index.description_match_summary: Creative dimension with creative_type (Image/Video/HTML5/Text). Join to slv_impression_event on creative_id to get impression volume per creative.

scoring_reference.formula: composite = (field_overlap x 0.30) + (source_compat x 0.15) + (granularity_align x 0.15) + (semantic_sim x 0.15) + (grain_compat x 0.15) + (freshness x 0.10)
